Entertainment.title: Lil Uzi Vert Weaves a Rainbow of Thread Into the Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos"
Entertainment.text: Name: Lil Uzi Vert x Vans Authentic 44 “Pink Cosmos”Colorway: Pink/Multi-ColorSKU: VN0010WY3TDMSRP: TBCRelease Date: Holiday 2026Lil Uzi Vert's Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos" is reportedly set to close out the year, giving one of the label's most pared-back silhouettes a heavily textured finish. The pair arrives as the rapper steps back into the spotlight with new music, so his latest era comes with footwear to match.The upper is made from a dense weave of multicolored threads. So many shades are packed in that the surface reads as tactile rather than printed, and it changes depending on how close you look. Pink is the loudest of the bunch, and it doesn't stay in the weave. It runs onto the eyelets and wraps the ankle collar, so the colorway holds together from toe to heel.Branding is kept to a few deliberate touches, which leaves most of the work to the woven upper. Inside, the insole carries a Vans logo with a "By Lil Uzi Vert" credit tucked underneath. A second Vans logo on the heel bumper anchors the back of the shoe.That restraint suits a silhouette that has always been about simplicity. The Authentic began as Style 44, the canvas deck shoe the Van Doren Rubber Company sold when it opened in Anaheim, California, in 1966. Skaters later adopted it for its grippy waffle outsole, and that makes 2026 the model's 60th year. A woven, pink-forward reading of it is a deliberate departure from the plain canvas the shoe built its name on.The pink is no accident either. The color has become a calling card for Uzi, most visibly through his 2023 album Pink Tape, and his wardrobe has long ignored the usual lines between menswear and womenswear. His ties to Vans go back to at least May 2025, when he fronted the label's Premium Old Skool campaign. Earlier this year he teased further collaborative designs online, including a pink and black checkerboard Slip-On and several takes on the chunky Lynzie skate shoe. Against those louder pieces, the Authentic is the most wearable entry yet.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Moncler x Rick Owens FW26 Arms Quilted Outerwear With Studs and Straps
Entertainment.text: SummaryMoncler and Rick Owens return with a Fall/Winter 2026 collection built mainly around quilted outerwearGeo Quilting, metal studs, oversized Tour pockets and a carry-ready Mega Strap appear across the lineupThe collection uses a tight palette of black, metallic Palladium, Cloud Grey and a muted Grease toneThe Moncler x Rick Owens Fall/Winter 2026 collection is built around outerwear. It brings Owens' subversive eye together with the Italian house's background in warm, protective technical gear. The two labels have shaped each other's work over time, and this season puts that exchange into a run of quilted pieces in a wide range of shapes.Quilting is the collection's backbone. A graphic Geo Quilting pattern breaks up the surfaces into sharp, architectural sections, so even the simpler shapes have an edge. Owens' hardware sits on top: metal studs run along the outerwear, and oversized Tour pockets add real storage without diluting the look.The most practical detail is the Mega Strap. It's a large carrying strap that lets you sling a jacket over your shoulder or across your body when you've taken it off, so heavy layers don't have to be either worn or left behind. It's a small change, but it makes these voluminous pieces easier to get through a day of changing temperatures with.The palette stays restrained so the textures stand out. Black anchors the range, and metallic Palladium adds a liquid shine, Cloud Grey softens the mix and Grease gives a quieter, lived-in tone. Entertainment.title: The Clock Starts Again as ‘The Pitt’ Season 3 Locks Its Premiere Date
Entertainment.text: Summary'The Pitt' returns to HBO Max for Season 3 on January 7, keeping its usual early-January premiere slotNoah Wyle leads a returning cast that includes Patrick Ball, Katherine LaNasa, Fiona Dourif and Shawn HatosyThe medical drama has won 12 Emmy Awards from 38 nominations across its first two seasonsHBO Max has set January 7, 2027 as the premiere date for The Pitt Season 3, bringing the Emmy-winning medical drama back to the emergency room for another year. The date keeps the show in the early-January slot it has held since its debut, when Season 1 premiered on January 9, 2025, and Season 2 followed on January 8, 2026.The core of the Pittsburgh trauma center is returning. Noah Wyle again plays Dr. Michael "Robby" Robinavitch, with Patrick Ball as Dr. Langdon, Katherine LaNasa as charge nurse Dana Evans and Fiona Dourif as Dr. McKay. Taylor Dearden (Dr. King), Isa Briones (Dr. Santos), Gerran Howell (Dr. Whitaker) and Shabana Azeez (Javadi) are also back. Ayesha Harris returns as Dr. Ellis, alongside Sepideh Moafi as Dr. Al-Hashimi and Shawn Hatosy as Dr. Abbot.One face won't be back on the floor. Supriya Ganesh, who played senior resident Dr. Samira Mohan, left the series ahead of Season 3. Her exit opens a gap in the residency ranks that the new season will have to work around.The creative team hasn't changed. R. Scott Gemmill created the show and executive produces with John Wells through John Wells Productions, alongside Wyle, Michael Hissrich, Erin Jontow, Joe Sachs, Simran Baidwan and Eli Attie. The series' official logline describes it as "a realistic examination of the challenges facing healthcare workers in today's America as seen through the lens of the frontline heroes working in a modern-day hospital in Pittsburgh."That focus on realism has paid off. Each season follows a single shift, with each episode covering roughly one hour in real time, so the format feels closer to a ticking clock than a typical procedural. Wyle's return to scrubs has its own history too. Science & Technology.text: SummaryApple is preparing a dual-phase rollout for the MacBook Air, starting with an M6 chip update in spring 2027The initial launch will be a straightforward spec refresh, arriving alongside the new MacBook Neo 2A major design overhaul featuring an OLED display is slated to follow in late 2027 or 2028During a Thanksgiving mailbag episode of his Power On podcast, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman fielded a listener Q&A segment that laid out the immediate roadmap for Apple’s most popular laptop. Titled "Mailbag: Mark Answers Your Questions About Apple’s Product & Political Future," the episode detailed major two-part release plans for the MacBook Air. According to Gurman, Apple is planning to launch new 13-inch and 15-inch iterations of the machine in spring 2027. Developed internally under the project codenames J913 and J915, these forthcoming models will officially introduce Apple's M6 chip to the lightweight laptop line. However, the spring drop isn't meant to reinvent the wheel. Gurman specifically described this spring 2027 release as a straightforward "chip and ship" refresh that brings minimal hardware changes to the table.When these M6-powered MacBook Air models hit the market, they are scheduled to launch right alongside an entirely new device known as the MacBook Neo 2. But while the internals are getting a performance boost, the exterior of the current generation is rapidly aging out. Gurman noted on the podcast that the current MacBook Air aesthetic is nearing the "end of the road." Apple originally introduced this specific industrial design language back in 2022 and updated the line by adding a larger 15-inch model to the roster in 2023.Because the MacBook Air is currently Apple's most popular computer, heavy pressure remains on the company to keep its hardware designs fresh and relevant. To answer that demand, Apple is aggressively developing a major design overhaul for the lineup, slated for release in late 2027 at the earliest, or potentially shifting into 2028. The focal point of this highly anticipated aesthetic revamp is expected to be the integration of an OLED display. Transitioning to OLED represents a massive leap for the machine, upgrading the visual fidelity of the brand's biggest seller to maintain its competitive edge.Executing two distinct MacBook Air generations within a single calendar year is an aggressive product cadence that mirrors a tested internal playbook. A minor spec bump in the spring followed by an overhaul in the fall directly tracks with Apple's recent strategy for the MacBook Pro. The tech giant utilized this exact formula when the MacBook Pro received an M5 chip update in March 2026 before launching a PROLED XDR redesign in October. Production will take place at Porsche’s Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen plant. Art & Culture.title: The dhow builders crafting giant historic ships in India – in pictures
Art & Culture.text: It takes three years for shipbuilders in the 16th-century port of Mandvi to complete a commission, in a trade that is as cultural as it is technicalIn the 16th century, the port city of Mandvi on India’s west coast was founded by the rulers of the kingdom of Kutch, and quickly established itself as one of the most dynamic ports in the western Indian Ocean. Its strategic geographical position, along the estuary of the Rukmavati River, which flows into the Arabian Sea in the Gulf of Kutch, and mastery of monsoon wind navigation enabled it to become part of vast maritime networks connecting India to the Gulf, the Arabian peninsula and east Africa.Mandvi prospered through trade, exporting cotton textiles, indigo, cereals and handicrafts, while importing dates, pearls, Arabian horses and luxury goods.A stemson, a piece of supporting timber in the bow of a boat, is carved from teak in a Mandvi shipyard under supervision by the master shipwright, or mistri, who designs boats without written plans. Longevity & Anti-Aging.title: Icariin Enhances Mitophagy in the Aging Brain, Reducing Inflammation
Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: Icariin is a flavonoid plant extract that has been studied in a number of contexts in recent years. Supplementation with icariin has been shown to improve the aged gut microbiome and slow a number of aspects of aging in mice. It also produces benefits in mouse models of neurodegenerative conditions. Further research on that front is presented here, showing that icariin supplementation enhances the operation of the mitochondrial quality control mechanisms of mitophagy. Mitophagy clears damaged and dysfunctional mitochondria, thereby enhancing mitochondrial function. Reduced mitophagy and loss of mitochondrial function are characteristic of aging and neurodegeneration; the brain has high energy demands, and is thus particularly vulnerable to impaired mitochondrial function. Longevity & Anti-Aging.title: ZNF865 Regulates Cellular Senescence in Intervertebral Disc Tissues
Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: Cellular senescence is strongly implicated in the onset and progression of degenerative disc disease, the atrophy and dysfunction of intervertebral discs in the spine. It is a prevalent cause of pain and loss of function in older people. Here, researchers explore the role of ZNF865 in regulating the senescent state in multiple cell types. While their work is focused on degenerative disc disease, it is likely applicable more broadly to other areas of the body, and may form a useful basis for senotherapeutics to reduce the burden of senescence and consequent dysfunction more generally. Senescence has been shown to contribute to the progression of aging-related diseases including degenerative disc disease (DDD). Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: Why does linking the circulatory systems of an old mouse and a young mouse both rejuvenate the old mouse and prematurely age the young mouse to some degree? The consensus position at the moment is that while there may be some beneficial factors in young blood that improve function in aged tissues, the majority of the effect occurs because there are harmful factors in old blood, and those factors are diluted in the old animal by the addition of a young animal's blood.
